variants.query_and_update: If ||grad f(x_t)||<=g_threshold and t-t_noise>t_threshold, save x_t as xtilde, set t_noise=t, replace x_t by xtilde+Uniform(B(0,r)). If t-t_noise=t_threshold and f(x_t)-f(xtilde)>-f_threshold, return xtilde. Otherwise x_{t+1}=x_t-eta grad f(x_t).
